items.title: FDA orders class-wide GLP-1 label update to include potential risk for rare eye disease
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Twelve marketed drugs, including Eli Lilly’s and Novo’s weight loss mega-blockbusters, will require a label change under the new FDA update.

items.title: Boehringer, Zealand’s obesity drug doesn’t elevate heart risk in key late-stage test
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): The Phase 3 results help clarify the safety profile of Zealand and Boehringer Ingelheim’s survodutide, but analysts do not think the drug will find utility beyond patients with liver-related risk factors.

items.title: Lilly to seek second sleep apnea approval after Foundayo reduces disease severity in Phase 3
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): If approved, the oral GLP-1 would be Eli Lilly’s second marketed drug for obstructive sleep apnea after the GIP/GLP-1 injectable Zepbound secured the first approval in the space in December 2024.

items.title: Vir's hepatitis delta combo tamps down virus as Gilead showdown looms
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Vir Biotechnology is targeting a mid-2027 regulatory submission for its monthly chronic hepatitis delta regimen, with head-to-head data against Gilead’s Hepcludex expected next quarter.

items.title: Update: Compass submits psilocybin depression drug for approval after stock wobbles
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Compass Pathways has completed an FDA filing for COMP360, with an expected launch in the first half of next year. The update follows a reported regulatory submission for Usona Institute’s own psilocybin candidate for depression last Monday.

items.title: J&J and Protagonist’s Icotyde improves psoriatic arthritis but AbbVie’s Skyrizi likely to reign
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): A Phase 3 trial showed that Johnson & Johnson and Protagonist Therapeutics’ oral therapy Icotyde improved psoriatic arthritis symptoms but AbbVie’s injectable is likely to hold court based on higher efficacy, analysts say.

items.title: Details from Novartis’ failed cardiovascular trial offer ‘little silver lining’ for rivals
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Full data from the Phase 3 HORIZON trial of Novartis' pelacarsen failed to show any apparent benefit, leading analysts to further reduce the odds of success for Lp(a)-lowering competitors such as Amgen’s olpasiran.

items.title: Argenx buyout of peptide engine and Big Pharma favorite UNP could top $1B
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Unnatural Products has risen from founder Joshua Schwochert’s garage to an acquisition deal, valued at up to $1.15 billion, to join argenx.

items.title: Update: FDA investigates Novartis' Zolgensma following 9 cases of tumors in treated patients
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): After Novartis confirmed the reports of tumors in patients who have been treated with the spinal muscular atrophy gene therapy, the FDA will determine if any regulatory action is needed for Zolgensma or for the pharma's similar product Itvisma.

items.title: Shortly after Vertex acquisition, Crinetics will cut 78 employees
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Follow along as BioSpace tracks job cuts and restructuring initiatives.

items.title: Novo’s troubled cardio drug could find niche in less sick patients
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): At the American Heart Association conference, investigators were supportive of further studying Novo’s IL-6 inhibitor ziltivekimab in patients with less severe cardiovascular and kidney disease.

items.title: Bayer wins FDA nod for a new kind of blood thinner
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Sunharbo’s U.S. approval is the first for a “Factor XIa” inhibitor, an anticipated class of medicines seen as a possible step forward in stroke prevention.

items.title: Vir hepatitis D drug succeeds in first pivotal study
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): A program that’s survived Vir’s pivot away from infectious disease research hit all of its study objectives and appeared more potent than a rival drug also in late-stage development.

items.title: Argenx to buy peptide platform in potentially billion-dollar deal
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): For $550 million up front, Argenx will take control of Unnatural Products’ “macrocyclic peptide” technology and direct it to develop oral, durable medicines for serious immune-mediated diseases.

items.title: Ramaswamy’s biotech baggage haunted his political run
